card.name: Numbers just before an 'or' alternative
card.fires_on: The last digit or unit word of a number or time span in dosing text, at the point where 'or' or 'to' may follow with an alternative (e.g. '20 mg or', '4 hours', 'Grade 1 or').

modes.label: Final digit of a dose or range
modes.description: The closing digit of a dose number, often just before 'mg' or an 'or'/'to' alternative.
modes.example: The recommended initial dose is 10 mg or 2<<0>> mg oral torsemide tablets once daily

modes.label: Time unit after a number
modes.description: The unit word 'hour' or 'hours' ending a time limit that may be followed by an alternative condition.
modes.example: Diluted intravenous solution in an infusion bag should be used within 4<< hours>> when stored at room temperature, or used

modes.label: Grade or fraction before 'or'
modes.description: A grade number or the word 'half' that is followed by an 'or' alternative.
modes.example: Nonhematologic toxicity should have recovered to Grade <<1>> or baseline Interrupt Bortezomib

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a coming 'either/or' style alternative, and it pushes down the plain word 'or' and similar additive words.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a number or time span where the text often goes on with 'or' and a second option.
